description:
High-tech frame

The soft tail frame made of high quality carbon steel has higher strength, stability and toughness, and can absorb vibration better; the driver will not be so easily tired while driving, enjoy the adventure on mountain roads, forest paths and highways.

Double suspension

Full suspension bike has better shock absorption, adapts to more terrain, gives you a more comfortable riding experience on rough roads and provides a more durable riding experience; In addition, the soft rear ensures that the tires are fully gripped to keep control when descending.

PROFESSIONAL DRIVE

The 21 speed gears are precise and easy to use, a wide range of gears gives you more control on climbs and clearance on descents, turns and jumps; Disc brakes help the rider stop immediately in all conditions, even in the rain.

XC Sport Tire

26 inch XC tires are faster to accelerate, easier to handle and more responsive than a larger wheel; Ideal for dual suspension MTBs; The double wall rim is not only more stable but also protects the tube; This wheel is suitable for both beginners and professional riders.

Installation instructions

The 17 inch frame fits riders from 152 cm - 178 cm tall; 85% pre-assembled, easy to assemble, installation tools included.

【Excellent choice for off-road mountain bike】
Lion is a Hiland professional mountain bike designed for riding oamong knobby mountains. With its bold colors and multiple triangular design, it can catch the eyes at first sight. Professional configurations allow it to easily conquer a wide range of terrains including mountain roads, forest paths and highways, and provide a smoother and more comfortable riding experience. Whether youth or adult, male or female, Lion could deliver a fun and durable experience for riders of all ages to enjoy their adventures!
